source_consistency_findings: The paper header prints August 18, 2026, while the arXiv version marker identifies v1 as 17 Aug 2026. The output uses the arXiv submission date for version identity and preserves the PDF header date in the SEA metadata note.

The SARC comparison agrees on verdict, placement, and response but differs on coverage semantics for the faithful export. The padded export removes those discrepancies; the outputs do not collapse these two export conditions.

The DEMM evaluation is described as external because it uses DEMM-Bench contracts and construction oracle, but Quipu was self-added as a ninth regime and the adapter and reader are study-authored. The appraisal treats this as partial external anchoring rather than independent external validation.
